description: Look up a company by registry number in Sweden (SE), Norway (NO), Finland (FI) or the UK (GB): official name, legal form, active/dissolved status, bankruptcy or liquidation, registration date, address and industry codes (+ employees, website, VAT where available). Official registry data. Costs $0.01 (USDC on Base, x402). Not charged if the company isn't found.

country.description: Country of registration: SE (Sweden), NO (Norway), FI (Finland), GB/UK (United Kingdom). Default SE.

id.description: Company registry number: Swedish organisationsnummer (556632-2938), Norwegian organisasjonsnummer (923609016), Finnish Business ID (0112038-9) or UK Companies House number (00445790).

name: get_company
title: Company profile (Sweden, Norway, Finland, UK)
